    (pvs !! k) else pvs !! k) : flagsOf pvs2 = (leaveJointState { cfg := c, prs := flagsOf pvs
    }).prs

theorem lj_step_del {V : Type} (mI m : GMap w64 V) (keys : List w64) (i : Int) (key : w64) (inc L :
    GMap w64 Unit) (Hi : 0 ≤ i) (Hkey : keys[i.toNat]? = some key) (H : ∀ (k : w64), mI !! k = if k
    ∈ List.take i.toNat keys ∧ ¬k ∈ inc ∧ ¬k ∈ L then none else m !! k) (Hdel : ¬key ∈ inc ∧ ¬key ∈
    L) (k : w64) : GMap.delete key mI !! k = if k ∈ List.take (i + 1).toNat keys ∧ ¬k ∈ inc ∧ ¬k ∈ L
    then none else m !! k
